title: MPAPASS - Creating an MPAPASS Database
author: Joshua A Welsh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bjnxkmfn
materials: Open the MPAPASS software and navigate to the Menu tab in the upper left-hand corner. Under the Menu tab, choose the New Dataset option and a new window will pop-up as shown below:

Outside of the MPAPASS software, navigate to the newly created .xlsx file and open it in Microsoft Excel. The file should be similar to the one shown below. Note the five worksheet tabs at the bottom of the file. In this protocol, we will only be competing the bare minimum necessary for the database to be imported.
If QC was successful, the software will allow for the import of the data. Click on the 'Import Data' button and the dataset will be constructed.

steps.title: Select CSV Directory
steps.instruction: Choose the folder containing all desired .csv files for data analysis by clicking the 'Select CSV Directory' button.

substeps.instruction: Verify that .csv files appear in the 'Directory Files' listbox
Confirm the 'Directory Selected' message appears in the command window

steps.title: Configure Bead Information
steps.instruction: Define the 'Bead Info' using the Identifier, Marker, and Isotype textboxes.

substeps.instruction: Enter the Identifier, Marker, and Isotype into their respective boxes and click 'Add Population'
To remove a population, highlight it and click 'Remove Population'
To save the configuration for future use, click 'Save Preset' and enter a name
Alternatively, use the automatically saved MACSPlex Human EV preset (recommended for MACSPlex Human Exosome Kit)

steps.title: Construct Database File
steps.instruction: Generate the initial database file by clicking 'Construct Database' and naming the resulting .xlsx file.

steps.title: Populate Sample Worksheet
steps.instruction: Fill out the Sample worksheet in the .xlsx file according to the following column requirements:

substeps.instruction: Sample_Filename_Prefix: Enter the filename of the exported .csv files (do not change unless the filename changes)
Sample_Set_ID: Group files (e.g., by cell line and concentration)
Sample_ID: Name the samples (must correspond to Sample Set ID; samples with the same Sample Set ID cannot have different Sample IDs)
Sample_Grouping_ID: Further classify samples related to Sample_Set_ID (samples with the same Sample Set ID cannot have different Sample Grouping IDs; fill with ones if not used)
Sample_Control_ID: Enter the ID of the file to be used as a control (linked to Controls worksheet)
Sample_Label_Mix_No: Enter the label mix used (linked to Labelling worksheet; no repeated numbers within a Sample Set ID)

steps.title: Populate Controls Worksheet
steps.instruction: Fill out the Controls worksheet in the .xlsx file according to the following column requirements:

substeps.instruction: Control_Filename_Prefix: Enter the filename prefix of the exported control .csv file
Sample_Control_ID: Assign a number to the control (this links to the Sample_Control_ID in the Sample worksheet)
Control_Name: Assign a name to the control .csv file
Sample_Label_Mix_No: Enter the label mix number (ensure there is a control for every Label Mix No)

steps.title: Populate Labelling Worksheet
steps.instruction: Fill out the Labelling worksheet in the .xlsx file according to the following column requirements:

substeps.instruction: Mix_Number: Assign an ID to different mixes (used in Sample and Controls worksheets under 'Sample_Label_Mix_No')
Import_Column_Number: Enter the column number of the gated/exported .csv data files to be imported (typically '1' if only one channel was exported from FlowJo)
Label_Target: Assign a target protein to each label mix

steps.title: Verify Beads and General Worksheets
steps.instruction: Review the Beads and General worksheets in the .xlsx file.

substeps.instruction: Beads worksheet: Contains Bead Info from step 2; no changes necessary for QC
General worksheet: Lists the CSV directory; do not change this worksheet

steps.title: Import Database into Software
steps.instruction: Save the completed .xlsx file, return to the MPAPASS software, click 'Import Database', and select the file.

steps.title: Perform Database Quality Control
steps.instruction: Click the 'Database QC' button to validate the imported database.

substeps.instruction: If QC fails, read the error message in the command window
Open and edit the .xlsx file to fix the identified error
Save the file, re-import it, and run QC again
